'''South New Ayre''' is a sub-continent located in the southern and noethern hemisphere. It is bordered the [[Sea of Miali]] and [[Southern Eanif Ocean]] to the south. [[Northern Eanif Ocean]] to the west, [[North New Ayre]] to the north, and the [[Rianian Sea]] to the east. The continent covers around {{convert|6,304,494|km2|sqmi|abbr=on}} of land, making it the 12th largest sub-continent in the world, with a total of about 165,545,073 as of 1765, making it also the 16th largest sub-continent by population.
